what: Baisakhi, the chief Hindu festival, held at the Gorakhnath tank; Dasehra on the jabba near the city; attracts large crowds
quote: The former takes place at the Gorakhnath tank, near Babu Garhi

what: Gor Khatri originally a place of Hindu pilgrimage, noted by Babar and Abul Fazl as a holy place of the jogis, who cut off hair and shaved beards; Cunningham identifies it with a Buddhist monastery; now the tahsil and guest house
quote: one of the holy places of the jogis of the Hinds, who came from great distances to cut off their hair and shave their beards at this Gor Khatri

what: Muhammadans and Hindus go in spring to the ziarat of Jogiano Sar on the Tortaba spur and camp three days; recreation described as devotion and debauchery
quote: parties of both Muhammadans and Hindis collecting there, set out for the zigrat of Jogiano Sar

what: Fakir in Yusufzai means a landless dependent (hamsaya), not a mendicant; Fakirkhel a Pathan section
quote: Fakir does not mean a mendicant, it is a man who lives on a site, the property of the Pathan whose land he cultivates
